title: 짐작하고, 다짐하고, 시키기: ~일걸, ~해야지, ~해라
objective: By the end, you can choose between -을걸(요), -어야지(요) and -어라 and form them correctly to make a guess, make a promise to yourself, or tell a younger or close person what to do.
summary: This worksheet compares three casual sentence endings: -을걸 for a guess, -어야지 for a promise to yourself, and -어라 for telling someone what to do.

task.title: Use the right ending
task.line: Read each situation, then choose, change, or check the ending as the instruction says.

forms.when: Guess. Stem ends in a vowel or ㄹ (ㄹ stays, no extra ㄹ added: 알다 → 알걸요). The end of the sentence goes up a little.
forms.exampleMeaning: I think that restaurant is closed on Mondays.

forms.when: Guess. Stem ends in a consonant (not ㄹ).
forms.exampleMeaning: If we go now, there probably won't be any seats.

forms.when: Guess about something that has already happened. Drop 요 with close friends.
forms.exampleMeaning: Suji has probably gone home already.
That person is probably the new teacher.

forms.when: Promise to yourself, often said to yourself. 하다 → 해야지.
forms.means: I will ~ / I'm going to ~ (I've decided)
forms.exampleMeaning: Starting tomorrow, I'm going to get up early.

forms.when: Polite form, said to another person about what you will or should do.
forms.exampleMeaning: I promised, so of course I'll go too.

forms.when: Command to a child, a younger person, or a close friend. -아라 after ㅏ/ㅗ, -어라 after other vowels.
forms.exampleMeaning: It's cold, so close the window.

forms.when: Command with 하다 verbs: 하다 → 해라.
forms.exampleMeaning: Stop playing games and do your homework.

watchOut: 비가 올껄요 (X) → 비가 올걸요 (O): It sounds like [껄], but you write 걸.
할머니, 이거 먹어라 (X) → 할머니, 이거 드세요 (O): -어라 is only for children, younger people, and close friends. To older people, it is rude.
조용해라 (X) → 조용히 해라 (O): Adjectives do not take -어라. Use an action verb.
제 이름은 민준일걸요 (X) → 제 이름은 민준이에요 (O): Use -을걸 only for guesses, not for things you know for sure.
exercises: Choose the right form for each situation: ① (You are guessing.) 그 영화는 벌써 (끝났을걸요 / 끝나라). ② (You make a promise to yourself.) 이번 달에는 돈을 (아껴야지 / 아낄걸). ③ (A mother speaks to her son.) 밖이 추우니까 모자 (써라 / 쓸걸).
Change the word in ( ) using -ㄹ걸요/-을걸요: ① 거기는 여기보다 (멀다). ② 그 바지는 지수 씨한테 좀 (작다). ③ 그 사람은 아마 (대학생이다).
Tell your younger brother what to do. Change the word in ( ) using -아라/-어라: ① 밥 먹기 전에 손을 (씻다). ② 여기 (앉다). ③ 방 좀 (청소하다).
Complete the sentence using -어야지 or -어야지요: ① (You spent too much money. You say to yourself.) 이제부터 돈을 (모으다). ② (Your boss says you did a good job. You reply politely.) 감사합니다. 앞으로 더 열심히 (하다).
Is the sentence correct? Write O or X. If X, fix it: ① (to your teacher) 선생님, 여기 앉아라. ② 내일은 아마 눈이 올걸요. ③ (about your own birthday) 내 생일은 5월 3일일걸. ④ 이번 주말에는 꼭 쉬어야지.
answers: ① 끝났을걸요 ② 아껴야지 ③ 써라
① 멀걸요 ② 작을걸요 ③ 대학생일걸요
① 씻어라 ② 앉아라 ③ 청소해라
① X → 선생님, 여기 앉으세요. ② O ③ X → 내 생일은 5월 3일이야. ④ O
